question.text: An observer is riding on a bicycle and moving towards a hill at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn><mo> </mo><mi>km</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. He hears a sound from a source at some distance behind him directly as well as after its reflection from the hill. If the original frequency of the sound as emitted by source is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>640</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi></math> and velocity of the sound in air is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>320</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, the beat frequency between the two sounds heard by observer will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Hz</mi></math>.
